journey.name: Presets
journey.description: Save the current settings as a preset from the Presets tab, put a built-in one on the Timer from its sheet, start one from its sheet, then edit and delete the saved one. Run on a fresh install (adb shell pm clear dev.justinsmith.interval), whose default workout matches no preset.

actions.action: Verify that "Yours" is shown above "Built-in", and "Yours" says "Save one from the Timer or the end of a workout."
Verify that a card captioned "On the Timer · not saved" is shown at the top with a "Save" button
Verify that a sheet titled "Save as preset" is shown, with a "Name" field whose placeholder is "30/15 ×8"
Verify that "Saves as Tabata 2" is shown under the field
Verify that a "Journey" card is shown under "Yours", captioned "On the Timer", and the "On the Timer · not saved" card is gone
Verify that a sheet is shown with "Built-in", "Tabata", "Start workout", "Put on Timer" and "Save a copy"
Verify that the Timer tab is shown and its total is labelled "Tabata · Total"
Verify that the "Tabata" card is captioned "On the Timer"
Verify that the sheet shows "Start workout" but no "Put on Timer", since Tabata is already on the Timer
Verify that the workout screen is shown with "Get ready"
Verify that the Presets tab is shown again
Verify that a sheet titled "Edit preset" is shown with the name "Journey" and a "7 / 24" count
Tap the "Rounds" row, tap "12" in the sheet, then tap "Done"
Verify that the "Journey" card says "30s on · 15s off · ×12" and is still captioned "On the Timer"
Verify that no "On the Timer · not saved" card is shown
Verify that a dialog titled "Delete Journey?" is shown saying "History keeps the workouts you did with it. The Timer keeps its settings."
Verify that the "Journey" sheet is still shown
Verify that "Journey" is no longer shown and "Yours" says "Save one from the Timer or the end of a workout."
Verify that the total is labelled "Custom · Total" and the title bar shows a "Save as preset" button
Verify that a sheet titled "Save as preset" is shown, then tap "Cancel"
